messages:
alex: Quick sync — FinData POC: they want a reserved+burst plan for production after POC. Need help with throughput sizing and suggested autoscale knobs. Timeline: 4-week POC starting next Monday.

maria: Can you drop the traffic profile they’ll run during POC? qps, avg tokens, latency SLO?

alex: From their doc: peak concurrent users ~150, peak QPS ~=120 for short runs, average response ~150 tokens, target p99 <= 400ms for ui flows. POC load will be 2h/day for 3 days.

sam: ok rough calc incoming.

sam: quick rough math:
```
# rough throughput calc (night-of napkin)
peak_qps = 120
avg_tokens = 150
peak_tokens_per_sec = peak_qps * avg_tokens  # 18000 tps
# estimate per-GPU token/sec (rw-13b-ish, fp16+batching) ~= 6000 tps
needed_gpus = ceil(18000 / 6000) = 3
# add 20% buffer for spikes / tail latency => 3.6 => round up to 4 GPUs
```

sam: so baseline for p99 headroom I'd recommend 4 GPUs for the POC if we run rw-13b fp16. If we use int8 quant + aggressive batching we might drop to 3.

maria: also note KV cache/prefix reuse matters — if they're doing multi-step chat with shared context we get big gains. Ask them for session length distribution.

kevin: Pricing question from them: they want committed discount tiers for Reserved GPUs vs burst. Any standard pitch?

alex: Sales asks: propose 3-tier commit (monthly): 2-GPU, 4-GPU, 8-GPU with stepped discounts. For POC we can offer temporary 4-GPU reserved for 30 days + burst credits and pro-rate if they convert. Can we give a 10% conversion credit?

sam: operational notes: autoscale policy we should use — min_reserved = 2, target_util = 0.6, max_burst_pool = 4, warm_pool = 1. Policy details: scale up when avg_util > 0.65 for 30s or queueing > 50ms; scale down when util < 0.4 for 2m.

maria: recommend using model variant fallback: primary rw-13b-quant, fallback rw-7b for extreme bursts; configure smart routing so requests degrade to rw-7b when queueing increases. That preserves SLA for availability though p99 latency will increase.

elaine: Security ask from FinData: they require KMS integration, VPC private deployment, and audit logs retained 1 year. They also asked about on-prem for regulated datasets. Can we scope?

sam: Private deployment ok, needs infra lead to scope. KMS + HSM supported. For POC we can run in their VPC via our Private offering (short trial) but we'll need signoff from infra and security. Add 2-week provisioning lead time.

alex: Good — action items: (1) maria to request session length and prefix reuse numbers from customer; (2) sam to draft autoscale policy and GPU counts (3) kevin to draft pricing with conversion credit option; (4) elaine to flag security kickoff and provisioning estimate.

maria: I'll ask for session histogram and example request traces. Also ask whether model outputs are long-running (embeds vs chat).

kevin: For pricing, I'll propose: 30-day POC reserved 4GPUs @ 20% off list for the term, conversion credit 15% of POC fees applied to 12-mo commit. If they want 12-mo commit on 4 GPUs we can go to 25% off.

sam: One more calc for ops: if we switch to quant int8 + KV caching reuse of 40% tokens, effective tokens/sec could drop to ~9000, so 2 GPUs might handle average but keep reserved min=2 + burst=2. Worth running a quick benchmark with their sample workload.

alex: I'll send them the ask list tonight. Can someone run a quick perf bench with a synthetic traffic script matching 120 QPS / 150 tokens on rw-13b fp16 and quant?

sam: i can run it tomorrow morning, will post numbers. tagging capacity-bot to create a perf run ticket.

capacity-bot: perf-run created: PR-4721 — target topology: 4x A100-80GB (fp16) and 3x A100-80GB (int8 sim), script: scripts/poc_traffic_runner.py, est runtime: 3h.

maria: perfect. Once we have bench numbers we can finalize recommended commit size and autoscale policy.

elaine: timeline check — POC starts Mon, need provisioning by Fri. Sam, is that 2-week lead you mentioned or can we short-circuit for trial infra?

sam: for Private instance full provisioning is 2 weeks. But for Dedicated trial on our host infra we can spin a 4-GPU pool in 48-72h if capacity available. I'll check capacity and update PR-4721.

alex: thanks team. I'll loop in the customer with the ask list and proposed POC reservation. Will update here after reply. :thumbsup:
